articles.title: Donald Trump, European Security, and the New “Big Three”
articles.description: After the midterm elections, some things have not changed. Planning continues for a meeting of the self-styled “Big Three”—Presidents Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin—on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation meeting later this month in Shenzhen. The post Donald Trump, European Security, and the New “Big Three” appeared first on American Enterprise Institute - AEI.

articles.title: The Institute Season 2 Surges to Number Three on MGM+ Streaming Charts
articles.description: The Institute season 2 becomes a top streaming hit on MGM+, ranking number three in the US. The show continues Stephen King's psychic horror legacy beyond the source novel.

articles.title: Stephen King’s Supernatural Horror Returns As A Massive Streaming Hit

articles.title: Aaron Paul To Play Music Mogul Jimmy Iovine In Universal’s ‘Snoop’; Giovanni Ribisi Also Set
articles.description: EXCLUSIVE: Snoop, the Snoop Dogg biopic from Universal Pictures, has added two more to its cast: Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad) and Giovanni Ribisi (Avatar). Paul will play Jimmy Iovine, the billionaire music mogul who via his Interscope Records’ distribution deal with Death Row Records, helped bring Snoop’s early work into the mainstream.
